text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Escalation policy 'hosted-inference' fired for INC-3160. Primary did not acknowledge. Secondary paged.

incident-bot: Trigger details: high 5xx rate from hosted inference cluster us-east-1. Queue depth spiking, 1200 inflight requests, autoscale not keeping up. Affected route: /v1/generate (model:gpt-redwood-11b).

olivia (oncall): acked but just saw this — getting dashboard now.

olivia (oncall): @sam can you check whether the secondary pool is healthy? the PD note says secondary didn't ack.

sam (secondary): sorry just woke up — DND on my phone. jumping in. saw the page, checking logs.

olivia (oncall): thanks. traffic shows elevated p95 latency + 502s. customers reporting failures. any quick mitigation?

anya (support): FYI support is already getting inbound tickets. tenant 'atlas-ai' reporting streaming failures, approx ~3% of requests failing with 502 over last 10m. affected customers count: 14.

sam (secondary): looking at the node list — several workers in us-east-1 show error: "CUDA out-of-memory: attempted to allocate 2.1 GiB" and subsequent fallback retries. KV cache thrashing maybe.

mike (infra): grabbing host-level metrics and autoscaler logs. quick check: autoscaler attempted new instances but hit quota limits for this account in us-east-1. Pending capacity 0.

olivia (oncall): oh — quota limit. can we temporarily route new requests to us-west-2?

mike (infra): we can. running canary route now. will update routing policy to prefer us-west-2 for non-privileged traffic. command:```rb
# apply temporary routing override
redwood route update --from us-east-1 --to us-west-2 --selector "route:/v1/generate" --ttl 900
```

infra-bot: routing update accepted, rollout started (10% -> 100% over 6m).

sam (secondary): after the routing change, error rate fell by ~60% in the canary. looks promising. still seeing some stranded requests in us-east queue that are retrying.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Secondary did not acknowledge within escalation window. Escalating to manager (raj).

raj (manager): on it. thanks for the signal. what's the customer impact level?

anya (support): marking SEV2 for now. 3% global error rate on generation endpoints, some enterprise tenants affected. CS has an active thread with top 3 impacted customers; they're asking for ETA.

olivia (oncall): timeline: routing change rolling, autoscale quota request in flight with cloud provider; estimated quota approval uncertain (TBD). mitigation plan: 1) keep routing override until quota resolved, 2) kick nodes in problematic pool (recycle), 3) investigate model memory footprint change from yesterday's image.

sam (secondary): doing a controlled recycle of faulty nodes:```bash
for host in $(cat stuck_hosts.txt); do ssh $host 'sudo systemctl restart redwood-runtime'; done
```

sam (secondary): recycling 6 hosts now. will monitor KV cache warmup impact.

mike (infra): cloud quota request submitted (support ticket 894321). escalated to on-call account rep. also provisioning a handful of spare gpus in us-west-2 to relieve pressure if needed.

olivia (oncall): CS please tell impacted tenants we're rerouting to a nearby region and expecting degraded latency for a short window. no data loss.

anya (support): message drafted and sent to affected accounts: "We're actively mitigating an availability issue affecting generation requests; traffic is being routed to an alternate region to restore success rates. We'll share updates within 30m."

sam (secondary): recycled hosts are coming back healthy. error rate down to 0.8% cluster-wide after routing at 100%. p95 latency increased ~150ms for routed requests but acceptable.

raj (manager): good. keep the routing in place until quota confirmed or we can stabilize us-east pool. who owns the postmortem?

olivia (oncall): I can take the postmortem — will include root cause analysis of autoscaler/quota and a followup to reduce model memory regression risk.

mike (infra): followup action: add cross-region warm spare pool for critical routes and alert if cloud quota is below threshold. filing infra ticket INF-6123.

sam (secondary): acked. apologies for the delay on my initial page — DND policy looks like it suppressed audible alerts for PD on my phone. raising a PD setting change for critical escalation to include SMS as fallback.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-3160 status changed to 'under control'.

olivia (oncall): marking this thread resolved for now. will keep an eye and reopen if error rate creeps up.

anya (support): customers updated. CS to follow up with SLA credits if required.

olivia (oncall): thanks everyone. taking action items: postmortem, PD escalation settings update, infra spare pool.

raj (manager): great coordination. we'll review in the tomorrow ops sync. :clap:

incident-bot: Note: follow-up reminders scheduled — postmortem due in 72h.
